body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below — every level a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance (caching, event-driven, zero idle cost); (3) **full vanilla parity on non-current maps**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection, foreign types in method bodies only. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. **See-below / cross-gap is ONLY sky<->surface**; basement is routing-only.
- Basement default solid rock; with Biomes! Caverns = living cavern (2026-07-21).
- Stairwells do NOT exchange heat (run-14).
- Sky-view mountain = ONE connected vanilla rock texture per stone type; native walls keep vanilla lips; fogged interior = vanilla fog (run #17, re-verified post-rework). **BM variant mode is the sanctioned exception (USER-VERIFIED 2026-07-22).**
- **OUTERMOST RING OF ANY SKY MASS IS ALWAYS AB_MountainTop lip (KindLedge)** (run #43). Hidden-valley breach notches flip Wall->Ledge along a 1-wide path — they preserve this (notch cells are rim cells).
- **MINED PEAK EXPOSES OPEN SKY**: gates are `level == 1`; must become "topmost level" if more levels ever land.
- **Pod transit handoff LATE**: `HandoffTicksToImpact = 22`.
- **DEPTH/HEIGHT CUES RETIRED (2026-07-22, run #50)**: below view PLUMB (exact mapping), dim 0.06, thin hairlines, wall-top reveal. No painted depth cues without explicit user direction. Iso-camera want lives in the separate Isometric View prototype.
- **ARCHITECTURE: single-map mesa model rejected** — stacked maps stay.
- **ALWAYS read `def.graphicData.Graphic` (live), never the stale `def.graphic` field** for rock appearance (run-53; lore: things). Caches key on the live Graphic reference.
- **Settings IMGUI discipline (lore-derived, in ABSettings header): deferred tab switch, snapshot-gated conditional rows, maxOneColumn + measured heights + unconditional gutter.**

## SETTINGS REWORK (2026-07-22) — BUILT, awaiting in-game check
Five tabs (vanilla TabDrawer + menu section), per-tab measured scroll + remembered position, per-tab reset button, reset-all with confirm (Advanced).
1. **Generation** (all creation-time; dim note says so): presets row (Default = full gen reset / Dramatic / Subtle / Lush — peak sliders only), skyBiomeInherit, naturalPeaks gating: plateau openness (remaps peakMeadowCutoff 0.75-0.45, default 0.60=50%), meadow size (peakMeadowScale 0.048-0.012, default 0.024), edge band width (peakTerraceMax 1-6, default 4 — TerraceWidth power curve reproduces old 1/2/3/4 quantiles at max=4), outcrop density (0-2x), **mountain lakes/tarns (NEW: shallow pools + deep hearts on plateaus, ~1/1400 cells at 1x, watered cells leave flora list)**, **hidden valleys (NEW: share of enclosed meadows kept sealed; rest breached via shortest 4-connected BFS wall cut -> canyon notch, runs post-outcrops pre-terrain)**, soil + vegetation; sky ore density (0-12/10k, default 6). Basement: basement ore density; BC-gated cavern group + chamber frequency (0.01-0.05, default 0.02 — also the scatterer-warning mitigation) + formation density (0-2x scatterer runs).
2. **View & camera**: live below, dim, slab edges, reveal(+width, live reprint), below scale (live reprint), select-in-place, ceiling hints, level widget, colonist bar, camera follow + lock.
3. **Work & logistics**: ten cross-level toggles + pipes + climb time.
4. **Combat & threats**: combat + auto-engage (indented), pod transit, infestation/sky drops + divert chance.
5. **Advanced**: column wealth, world integration, verbose logging, **kill-switch status panel** (ABGuard.AllSwitches + IsOn/LastContext readouts, red rows with Re-arm buttons, green all-clear line; Disable now records lastContext), reset-all.
Defaults all equal old constants — untouched sliders change nothing. New scribe keys additive.

## Below-view rendering — current state (USER-VERIFIED 2026-07-22)
Pure altitude transform; ScreenToBelowPos identity (single inversion point); mask air-cells-only, dim 0.06; skirt = thin hairline per slab edge; wall-top reveal; below things per air cell, multi-cell anchor = first air-covered occupied cell, shrink 0.85 except linked + rock/ores by def (BM-proof). SectionLayer_ABWallFacade retired shell; ABRimFacade deleted (git).

## COMPAT TRANCHE (2026-07-22) — ALL USER-VERIFIED
1. Sky biome inheritance (skyBiomeInherit, creation-time PrimaryBiome deep-scribe).
2. MO rock formations below-print anchor fix (generic multi-cell).
3. BM variant mode (live-graphic detection, per-cell deterministic variants, no fillers; caches validated by Graphic reference; EnsureQueue samples all terrain families). Probe reports fill branch/material/tint/queues per cell.

## PARITY TRANCHE — COMPLETE (runs #1-#15, USER-VERIFIED); pod transit + AA verified #39.

## 2026-07-21 TRANCHE (runs #40-#47)
1. Destination-aware stair routing — BUILT, self-test green. 2. BC cavern basements — WORKING (Earthen 55C; known-benign scatterer warning, now mitigable via chamber slider). 3. Naturalistic peaks — verified #47, self-test green through #53 on inherited biome. 4. Camera level lock (End). Fixes: run-40 wildPlants dictionary; run-41 auto-roof guard NRE.

## Dev-tools ("As above")
ensure sky+basement; combat / auto-engage / targeting-hub / animal-wander / ritual-attendance / mech-overseer / bond+home / pod-transit / stair-routing / cavern-basement / peak-plateau self-tests; below-view diagnostic; probe ledge cell (with fill branch report); toggle cap corner fillers.

## Prior verified features (unchanged)
Select in place; bidirectional right-click orders + Reverse Commands; merged colonist bar; stairs/elevators; cross-level power/pipes; work/haul/supply/needs/medical/prisoners; see-below renderer; opt-in threats; world integration; modder API.

## Compat
DBH water riser, VEF duct, Rimefeller + VCHE risers. Biomes! Caverns (soft). Better Mountains (verified). Medieval Overhaul formations (verified). AA interception (#39). INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded. CE out of scope.

## Status
2026-07-22: Settings rework built (tabs, gen knobs incl. NEW tarns + hidden-valley breach, presets, guard panel). Next: in-game settings walkthrough + a gen run with tweaked sliders (set sliders BEFORE running ensure sky+basement — gen reads them at creation), then older outstanding items (mech overseer, bond/home, VCHE run), soak, publishing prep. Save points: pre-height-language, pre-compat-tranche, pre-cue-removal, pre-settings-rework.
